title: Iraya Mangyan Culture: Traditions, Beliefs, and Way of Life
text: The Iraya speak their own language, commonly referred to as Iraya or Iraya Mangyan, which belongs to the broader Austronesian language family. While many Iraya people can communicate in Filipino or other regional languages, Iraya remains a powerful marker of identity and belonging.
